description.value: Tim Hortons on Highway 97 South is a well-known Canadian chain stop in Williams Lake, a key hub along the Cariboo cycling corridor. It offers coffee, baked goods, breakfast wraps, soups, and a full takeout menu alongside a drive-through and dine-in seating. For touring cyclists passing through the interior of BC on Highway 97, it represents a familiar and predictable resupply point in an otherwise rural stretch.

address.value: 1059 Highway # 97 South, Williams Lake, BC V2G 2W3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Tim Hortons location page confirms the business at 1059 Highway #97 South in Williams Lake, matching the OSM coordinates. Wi-Fi ('Has WiFi') and takeout ('Take Out') are both explicitly listed as features on the website, corroborating OSM tags internet_access=wlan and takeaway=yes. The website hours data shows the location as closed Monday–Saturday with only Sunday hours, which contradicts OSM's opening_hours=24/7 and is flagged as a data-integrity concern requiring verification.
concerns: Hours data discrepancy: OSM tags this location as open 24/7, but the Tim Hortons website shows it as closed most of the week with hours only on Sundays. This may be a website data-entry error or may reflect a significant reduction in operating hours. Verify current status before publishing.
OSM street name 'Cariboo Highway' differs from the website's 'Highway # 97 South'; these refer to the same road (Highway 97) but the naming variant may cause confusion in geocoding or wayfinding.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible Tim Hortons on Highway 97 in Williams Lake, confirmed via the chain's own location page. A practical resupply point on a key Cariboo cycling route.
